name: branch-multi-case-second-matches
description: branch with multiple cases: the first case's status does not match, the second matches on status and body together, and its inline steps run
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: branch multi case
proxy: optional
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- capture: "POST /login as: loginRsp"
- branch:
    from: loginRsp
    on:
      - match:
          status: 200
        do:
          - screenshot: unexpected
      - match:
          status: 401
          body:
            "$.requiresOtp": true
        do:
          - screenshot: otp-required
    default:
      - screenshot: fallback
